face = shell coverage minus cavity, rod and bob; no cavity fill
r2Tap evaluates same visible source and current swing/clapper geometry; two inward samples feed small same-source display bloom
clearBg excludes shell/cavity/rod/bob/lug/fixed mount; finite shell-distance taper
sRGB applied once at existing final output; no new texture/Canvas/particle
existing live boundary and 1170ms finite lifetime retained
phObs: Mechanical UI bell metaphor, authored display emission and bounded observer bloom distinguished; no world heat or lighting/gameplay state inferred
reducedMotion: original body swing .27, emission times unchanged; unchanged source verified
approximation: two inward source samples with silhouette taper are a display bloom approximation, not exact PSF/convolution or world illumination
limits: whole-body luminosity, material/opening readability and optical spread at actual default-size normal-speed are not_run
performance and driver shader/pipeline/GPU submission are not_run
ordinary audio listening, full-lifetime natural playback, Safari/iPad and game integration are not_run
